The environment in China is awful, this is certain. What's less certain is what's going to happen next. Much to my amazement the air quality in my part of China has noticeably improved this year compared to any of the past 3 years. Whether this is benevolent government in action or just a positive side-effect of the on-going manufacturing industry slowdown is open for debate, but blue skies are blue skies.

Global climate change aside, those outside China can take comfort in the knowledge that 99% of China's environmental woes are confined within its borders. I wish China was clean. It could be some day. But I doubt any of us will still be alive to see it.
